brief: Review the retry in invoice_export/client.py: can a retry after a timeout book one invoice twice? Recommend one regression test.

assign-timeout.body: Trace the timeout path in invoice_export/client.py. Can a retry submit twice?

assign-fixtures.body: Find a fixture in tests/ that can make the first API call time out.

timeout-found.body: The retry call site is client.py:17. Which fixture can make that call time out once?

lead-ack.body: Noted: smallest fix, no new dependencies. I will hold the team to it.

fixtures-ack.body: Will do. SlowOnceApi already times out once, so no new fixture is needed.

timeout-answer.body: Yes. client.py:15 makes a new request_id on every attempt, so the API sees two requests for one invoice.

lead-new-task.body: Add a regression test: every retry of one invoice must send the same request_id.
